answer: A payout is split so that 59% arrives at settlement and the rest over 10 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The signal schedule is applied in copper and forge shows each instalment. An adversary therefore cannot take the money and run, since most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 4290 identities would post 1526 proofs and burn roughly 60 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
